All three of these compounds have a shared target, HuT78, indicating a possible pathway where Colenemol may influence HuT78 through these intermediaries. The scores from the three paths, though slightly varying, all indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, suggesting that Colenemol may act as a modulator or activator of the Dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase, which in turn affects HuT78. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, but the exact nature of Colenemol's interaction remains uncertain, as the specific molecular pathways and mechanisms are not fully elucidated.
